items.title: 1.6 Aakhri nateeje mein kul uncertainty ka andaza (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.6 with Examples 1.1 to 1.3 (PDF 12-14).

blocks.text: Kisi hisab mein shamil sab factors ki uncertainties jaan kar aakhri nateeje mein zyada se zyada mumkin uncertainty ya error yun maloom ki ja sakti hai.

Absolute uncertainties jama ki jati hain. Maslan, do maqamat x1 = 15.4 +/- 0.1 cm aur x2 = 25.6 +/- 0.1 cm ke darmiyan faasla x = x2 - x1 = 10.2 +/- 0.2 cm record hota hai, aur do lambaiyon l1 = 8.5 +/- 0.1 cm aur l2 = 12.6 +/- 0.1 cm ki jama l = l1 + l2 = 21.1 +/- 0.2 cm record hoti hai.

Percentage uncertainties jama ki jati hain. Maslan, kisi conductor ki resistance R mein zyada se zyada mumkin uncertainty, jo us par lagaye gaye potential difference V aur nateeje mein bahne wale current I se tay hoti hai, yun andaza hoti hai. Farz karein V = 3.4 +/- 0.1 V aur I = 0.68 +/- 0.05 A, R = V/I istemal karte hue. V mein percentage uncertainty (0.1 V / 3.4 V) x 100 = 3%, aur I mein (0.05 A / 0.68 A) x 100 = 7% hai. Is liye R mein kul percentage uncertainty 3 + 7 = 10% hai. R ki qeemat R = 3.4 V / 0.68 A = 5.0 ohm hai, jo R = 5.0 +/- 0.5 ohm likhi jati hai; uncertainty, sirf andaza hone ki wajah se, ek significant figure tak record hoti hai.

Percentage uncertainty ko formula ke power factor se zarb diya jata hai. Maslan, r = 1.25 cm radius wale cylinder ka cross-sectional area A = pi r^2 se nikalne mein A mein percentage uncertainty r ki percentage uncertainty ka 2 guna hai. Chunke uncertainty power factor se zarb hoti hai, yeh paimaish ki precision ki maang barhati hai. Jab chhote sphere ka radius 0.01 cm least count wale Vernier callipers se 1.25 cm napa jaye, to radius r = 1.25 +/- 0.01 cm record hota hai; r mein percentage uncertainty (0.01 / 1.25) x 100 = 0.8% hai; A mein kul percentage uncertainty 2 x 0.8 = 1.6% hai; yun A = pi r^2 = 3.14 x (1.25)^2 = 4.906, 1.6% uncertainty ke saath, aur nateeja A = 4.91 +/- 0.08 cm^2 record hona chahiye.

blocks.alt: Baen: kul uncertainty ke teen qawaid kitab ke adad ke saath: lambaiyon ki tafreeq aur jama, V aur I se resistance, radius se area, aur Examples 1.2 aur 1.3. Daen: paanch bunyadi dimensions, speed, acceleration aur force ki dimensions, equation of motion ki homogeneity ki jaanch, centripetal force ke formula ki derivation, aur hadood. Neeche: thumb rule aur side-box haqaiq.
blocks.caption: Aakhri nateeje mein kul uncertainty aur physical quantities ki dimensions (topics 1.6 aur 1.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Jab quantities jama ya tafreeq hon to un ki absolute uncertainties jama hoti hain, to centimetre ke daswein hisse tak maloom do lambaiyan do daswein tak ghair-yaqeeni jama ya farq deti hain. Jab zarb ya taqseem hon to un ki percentage uncertainties jama hoti hain, to teen percent tak maloom voltage aur saat percent tak maloom current das percent tak maloom resistance dete hain, uncertainty ek significant figure tak likhi hui. Formula ki power percentage uncertainty ko us power se zarb deti hai, to radius ke muraba se area radius ki percentage uncertainty ka do guna rakhta hai. Dimensions kisi quantity ko length, mass, time, current aur temperature ke zariye bayan karti hain; durust equation ke dono taraf ek jaisi dimensions hoti hain, jo equation of motion ki jaanch karti hain, aur yeh farz kar ke ke force mass, speed aur radius ki powers par munhasir hai aur dimensions mila kar centripetal force mass zarb speed ka muraba taqseem radius milti hai, dimensionless constant tajurbe par chhorte hue.

blocks.title: Example 1.1
blocks.text: Dhaat ki sheet ki lambai, chaurai aur motai 2.03 m, 1.22 m aur 0.95 cm hain. Volume V = l x b x h = 2.03 m x 1.22 m x 0.95 x 10^-2 m = 2.35277 x 10^-2 m^3. Chunke factor 0.95 cm mein significant figures sab se kam, do, hain, volume do significant figures tak record hota hai: V = 2.4 x 10^-2 m^3.

blocks.title: Example 1.2
blocks.text: Lever balance se napa dhaat ke dabbe ka mass 3.25 kg hai; beam balance se nape 10.01 g aur 10.02 g ke do chandi ke sikke us mein dale jate hain. Kul mass = 3.25 kg + 0.01001 kg + 0.01002 kg = 3.27003 kg. Chunke sab se kam precise mass, 3.25 kg, do decimal places rakhta hai, kul mass do decimal places tak likha jata hai: kul mass = 3.27 kg.

blocks.title: Example 1.3
blocks.text: 0.01 cm least count wale Vernier callipers se nape dhaat ke cylinder ka diameter aur lambai 1.25 cm aur 3.35 cm hain. Lambai mein absolute uncertainty = 0.01 cm, lambai mein percentage uncertainty = (0.01 cm / 3.35 cm) x 100 = 0.3%; diameter mein absolute uncertainty = 0.01 cm, diameter mein percentage uncertainty = (0.01 cm / 1.25 cm) x 100 = 0.8%. Volume V = pi r^2 l = pi (d^2 / 4) l, to V mein kul uncertainty = 2 x (diameter ki %age uncertainty) + (lambai ki %age uncertainty) = 2 x 0.8 + 0.3 = 1.9%. V = 3.14 x (1.25 cm)^2 x 3.35 cm / 4 = 4.1089842 cm^3, 1.9% uncertainty ke saath, yun V = (4.11 +/- 0.08) cm^3, jahan 4.11 cm^3 hisab shuda volume aur 0.08 us mein uncertainty hai.

In safhon ke side boxes: rangeen chhapai is kitab ke rangon ki poori range banane ko sirf chaar rang, cyan, magenta, yellow aur black, istemal karti hai; aur roshni ka safar ka waqt Chand se Zameen tak 1 min 20 s, Suraj se 8 min 20 s, aur Pluto se 5 h 20 s hai.

blocks.prompt: Pendulum ka period T = 2.00 +/- 0.01 s aur us ki lambai l = 99.5 +/- 0.1 cm napi gayi. g = 4 pi^2 l / T^2 se nikale g mein percentage uncertainty kya hai (numerical problem 1.5 ki tarz par)?
blocks.explanation: l mein percentage uncertainty = (0.1 / 99.5) x 100 = 0.1%; T mein = (0.01 / 2.00) x 100 = 0.5%, aur T ka muraba hai, to us ka hissa 2 x 0.5 = 1.0%. Taqseem percentage uncertainties jama karti hai, to kul 0.1 + 1.0 = 1.1%, taqreeban 1%; g = 4 x 9.87 x 0.995 / 4.00 = 9.82 m s^-2, jo 9.8 +/- 0.1 m s^-2 record hota hai.

items: Jama ya tafreeq: absolute uncertainties jama (x = 10.2 +/- 0.2 cm). Zarb ya taqseem: percentage uncertainties jama (3% + 7% se R = 5.0 +/- 0.5 ohm). Power: percentage uncertainty ko power se zarb (A = pi r^2: 2 x 0.8% = 1.6%, A = 4.91 +/- 0.08 cm^2).
Misalein: V = 2.4 x 10^-2 m^3 (do significant figures); kul mass 3.27 kg (do decimal places); cylinder V = (4.11 +/- 0.08) cm^3 (1.9%).
